ci: publish the website only when main matches the released packages (#1884)

* ci: publish the website only when main matches the released packages

While main has pending changesets, the guide and the API reference would
describe changes that are not on npm yet. The deploy now waits for the
Version Packages commit, which consumes them; changes merged meanwhile go
live with the release. A manual run can publish anyway.

On main, a newer push no longer cancels a running build, so the run of a
release is not replaced by one that cannot publish.
